nodes.label: Core resolver model (baseline / enrichment / curation / decisions)
nodes.rationale: The file layer is baseline/default truth; provider enrichment is an additive shadow never flattened into the file layer; the pure resolver is the sole merge point; standing per-field source decisions plus curation override precedence at resolve time; Person and Studio ride the same decision model as entity-generic BaselineSource.
nodes.norm_label: core resolver model (baseline / enrichment / curation / decisions)

nodes.label: Branch↔Jira linkage
nodes.rationale: GitHub-for-Jira only links branches/PRs/builds/deployments to an issue when the issue key substring is present in the branch name. In Progress has no server-side event, so the agent fires it via direct Jira REST at branch-rename; CI fires In Review (PR marked ready), Done (merge), and Released (ghcr deploy) via direct REST calls rather than the metered Jira Automation Free-plan quota.

nodes.label: Tokens-only styling rule
nodes.rationale: Hardcoded palette/radius values won't react to skin switching, so all component styling must route through semantic CSS-variable-backed Tailwind utilities (bg-bg, text-ink, rounded-theme, etc); skin-specific flourishes are gated in app.css by [data-theme], not per-component markup.

nodes.label: QA all three skins rule
nodes.rationale: Regressions routinely appear in only one skin (Cinémathèque, Broadcast, Brutalist), so every UI change must be eyeballed in all three, with fonts loading offline and loading/empty/error/grid states themed.

nodes.label: Append-only migrations rule
nodes.rationale: golang-migrate has no auto-rollback, so a shipped migration is never edited — a new sequential NNNN_name.up.sql plus matching .down.sql is added instead.

nodes.label: Sidecar HTTP-only boundary rule
nodes.rationale: providers/tmdb is a standalone sidecar in the same Go module that must not import internal/*; it talks to core only over a versioned HTTP protocol (/healthz, /describe, /resolve, /enrich), keeping providers swappable without coupling to core internals.

nodes.label: HOLODEX-173/220 draft-PR guardrail incident
nodes.rationale: Standalone gate-artifact PRs (spec/ADR/design-handoff/worklog, e.g. #131/#137/#139/#181) were opened non-draft and each independently fired the Done transition on merge, cascading to Released on the next deploy, even though a docs-only merge can't be the PR that finishes an epic's implementation. Fixed by a 'Check changed paths' step that skips the Done transition when every changed file is under docs/**.

nodes.label: ADR-058: Direct Jira REST Transitions
nodes.rationale: Jira Automation on the Free plan meters a shared 100-run/month quota; direct REST API calls for status transitions are uncounted, so both the agent-fired In Progress transition and CI-fired In Review/Done/Released transitions bypass that quota.

nodes.label: ADR-070: Canary Release Candidate + Retag Promotion
nodes.rationale: Rebuilding the image again at release time risked shipping bits different from what was canaried, so a v* release instead retags the already-built, already-scanned sha-<short> digest from main. scripts/resolve-release-digest.mjs asserts ancestry to the tagged commit before promoting, guaranteeing released bits are byte-identical to the release candidate that was canaried.
